reviews.reason: Not an integration error: the face's wire does not close in UV. Pcurve 122 (edge 144) ends at (1.2559760966219999, 0.27960641085799998) and pcurve 193 (edge 223, reversed) starts at (1.2559760966719999, 0.27960641060899999), a gap of (5.0e-11, -2.49e-10) on a bilinear plane patch (|S_u x S_v| = 1e6), 2.5e-7 in space. The kernel closes its loops with the UV chord; BRepGProp sums Green's integrals over the open pcurves from the face's UMin (0.008725493121618), which closes the gap through u = UMin and drops a sliver 1.25 long and 2.49e-10 wide: 3.1e-4 of area, 2.0e-9 relative. Default and adaptive integration agree with that open sum, so only the area leaves the MEASURE_BOUND allowance.
